teaser.en: Turn a leaf over: green on top, pale beneath. That two-tone leaf is how the Digo pick out mweza.
teaser.sw: Geuza jani: juu ni kijani, chini ni jeupe-jeupe. Jani hilo la rangi mbili ndilo Wadigo hutumia kuutambua *mweza*.

summary.en: Mweza is a small herb of the amaranth family that Digo plant users recognise from its two-coloured leaves. Pakia records it as one of the few plants identified mainly by leaf colour.
summary.sw: Mweza ni mmea mdogo wa familia ya michicha ambao Wadigo wanaotumia mimea huutambua kwa majani yake ya rangi mbili. Pakia anauripoti kama mmoja wa mimea michache inayotambulika hasa kwa rangi ya majani.

about.en:
*Mweza* is a herb of the amaranth family, a relative of the chaff-flowers (*Achyranthes*). Plants in this genus usually carry their tiny flowers in long, thin spikes, with the flowers bending back against the stem as they age.

The Digo know *mweza* by its leaves. The upper side is green and the underside is distinctly whitish, and people describe it with the phrase *ndani n'maru, konze n'mereru*: green on the upper surface, whitish below.
about.sw:
*Mweza* ni mmea wa familia ya michicha, ndugu wa jenasi *Achyranthes*. Mimea ya jenasi hii kwa kawaida huzaa maua yake madogo sana kwenye vishada virefu vyembamba, na maua hujipinda kurudi nyuma kuelekea shina yanapozeeka.

Wadigo huutambua *mweza* kwa majani yake. Upande wa juu ni wa kijani na upande wa chini ni mweupe-mweupe waziwazi, na watu huueleza kwa msemo *ndani n'maru, konze n'mereru*: kijani upande wa juu, mweupe-mweupe chini.

where.en: Pakia collected it in Digo country on the south coast. No more detail on its habitat is recorded, but its relatives are common in bush, field edges and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Pakia aliukusanya katika nchi ya Wadigo, pwani ya kusini. Hakuna maelezo zaidi kuhusu mazingira yake yaliyoripotiwa, lakini mimea ya jamii yake ni ya kawaida vichakani, pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa.

culture.en: Digo colour words are few, mostly black, white and red, so colour rarely separates one plant from another. *Mweza* is an exception, together with *mtsunduzi* (*Croton megalocarpoides*): both are told apart by the contrast between the two sides of the leaf.
culture.sw: Maneno ya rangi katika Kidigo ni machache, hasa nyeusi, nyeupe na nyekundu, kwa hiyo rangi mara chache hutofautisha mmea mmoja na mwingine. *Mweza* ni tofauti, pamoja na *mtsunduzi* (*Croton megalocarpoides*): yote miwili hutambulika kwa tofauti ya rangi kati ya pande mbili za jani.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mweza*; its meaning is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Pakia gives the scientific name as *Achyranthus emerginatus*, a spelling that does not match a currently accepted species, so its exact identity needs checking. A better-known relative, *Achyranthes aspera*, is *mphulula mbuzi* in Digo.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo *mweza*; maana yake haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Pakia anatoa jina la kisayansi kama *Achyranthus emerginatus*, tahajia isiyolingana na spishi yoyote inayokubalika kwa sasa, kwa hiyo utambulisho wake halisi unahitaji kuthibitishwa. Ndugu yake anayejulikana zaidi, *Achyranthes aspera*, kwa Kidigo ni *mphulula mbuzi*.

reason.en: also identified by its two-coloured leaves
reason.sw: nao hutambulika kwa majani yake ya rangi mbili

taxon.note: "Achyranthes emarginata" is not an accepted name; genus-level reference
